findings.problem: The bare prompt German could also mean the language (Deutsch, with a capital, as in Ich spreche Deutsch) or a German person (der Deutsche / die Deutsche), so it needs a hint saying it is the adjective.
findings.fix: hint: adjective, as in German beer; not the language or a person

back.target: German (adjective: of or from Germany, or in the German language)
back.example: I like to drink German beer.

note: The Spanish card ingles-english means English, not German, so leaving sameAs null is right.
